defensiveAbilities.name: Reactive Strike
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Meteoric Death Drop
offensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per day

Requirements The tergaiator has a creature Grabbed

Effect The tergaiator launches themself and their victim high up in the air before crashing down. The creature takes 5d8 Bludgeoning Damage damage and 1d6 Fire Damage damage with a Basic DC 30 Fortitude Saving Throw save. On a failure, the creature also falls Prone in an unoccupied adjacent square of the tergaiator's choice; on a critical failure, the creature is also Stunned 1. After using Meteoric Death Drop, reduce the tergaiator's size by one category, their reach by 5 feet, and their Strike damage by 2 for 1 day.

offensiveAbilities.name: Orbital Lariat
offensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per minute

Effect The tergaiator hurtles toward their foes, using the momentum to launch a spinning flurry of attacks with outstretched arms. They Stride and make a melee Strike against any number of creatures within reach at the end of their movement. Each Strike applies to the tergaiator's multiple attack penalty, but the multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after they make all of their attacks. After making these attacks, the tergaiator is also Clumsy 1 until the start of their next turn.
